boundary.words: I approve the name. Keep the approved split. Mission 2 should just be on those things. Delivery belongs to the other one.

overview.words: okay, that's fair. Fine by me. I'll deal with the consequences of that.

feedback.text: Add an All events option beside the period buttons - not only upcoming - so an operator can see everything. Every sort and every filter must work there.
Remove the explanatory callout at the bottom. It is a mockup annotation and would not exist in the real UI.
The event name must be a hyperlink to the event page.
At 375 the period buttons take too much of the top of the screen; events should appear much sooner. Condense the period control and the rows themselves.
Remove the explanatory callout. Keep the split between what has occurred and what has not - that part is right.
Drop the 'no link shown' chip. Showing 'Online' is enough; the absence of a link needs no label.
Remove the explanatory callout. The public data set itself is right.
Add a subscribe / add-to-calendar action beside Create event. An operator subscribes to the calendar too.
Remove the season selector from the calendar entirely. The page header already says which season this is, so the control tells the reader nothing they do not have.
Remove the two callouts at the bottom. The Oxford calendar itself looks right.
Remove the 'Keep up with the club' block at the bottom. The Add to your calendar action in the top right is enough.
